review:
Pin-up Bonanza mixes BGaming's group-payout Bonanza engine with a retro pin-up style. Fruits and scatters pay anywhere, refilling after each win to create possible chains.

The multiplier symbol only appears in the free spins round and stays on screen until the refill sequence finishes, taking a random value as it lands. Chance x2 raises the bet to make the bonus more likely, and the bonus buy ensures four or more scatters on the next spin. BGaming rates it high volatility, with a 15,000x maximum and a 96% RTP. Free spins land around once every 395 spins on average. The theme is the main thing that sets it apart from its siblings.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
